title: Long Amplicon Nanopore Sequencing for Dual-Typing RdRp and VP1 Genes of Norovirus
author: George Scott
materials: Install all the required software using mamba: $ mamba create --name=amplion_analysis_norovirus duplex-tools=0.2.14 cutadapt=3.4 seqtk=1.3 minimap2=2.24 yacrd=1.0.0 kma=1.4.9 seqkit=2.3.0 samtools=1.13 bedtools=2.30.0 cd-hit=4.8.1 pyfastx=0.8.4 $ mamba create --name=NGSpeciesID medaka=1.2.2 bcftools=1.11 python=3.6.10 perl=5.32.0 openblas=0.3.3 spoa=4.0.7 racon=1.4.20 minimap2=2.17 tensorflow=2.4.1 $ mamba activate NGSpeciesID $ pip install NGSpeciesID==0.1.3
Leave to stand at room temperature for 00:05:00
Briefly spin down the reaction tubes
Load 10 µL of D5000 reagents into the 0.2 mL TapeStation reaction tubes
Briefly vortex and spin down ExoSap-IT
Add 198 µL High-Sensitivity dsDNA Qubit™ reagents to Qubit tubes for each sample being quantified
Add 190 µL High-Sensitivity dsDNA Qubit™ reagents to Qubit tubes for your standards
Cap tubes, vortex and briefly spin down
Briefly vortex and then spin down
Defrost all other components at Room temperature
Briefly vortex and spin down all components
Activate the correct software environment: $ mamba activate amplion_analysis_norovirus

steps.title: Prepare Primers
steps.instruction: Reconstitute and dilute primers for Norovirus GI and GII.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilised primers to 100 µM using TE buffer pH 8.
Dilute primers to a working concentration of 10 µM in molecular biology grade water and aliquot to avoid freeze-thaw cycles.

steps.title: Clean RNA Extract
steps.instruction: Perform bead-based purification of the RNA extract.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 25 µL of RNA extract into a 96-well PCR plate.
Add 45 µL (1.8X) of Mag-Bind® Total Pure NGS beads and mix by pipetting 10x.
If liquid is on the side of the wells, seal the plate and briefly spin down.
Place on a magnetic rack for 3 minutes.
Remove 68 µL of supernatant.
Add 80 µL of fresh 80% (v/v) ethanol for 30 seconds.
Remove 82 µL of supernatant, avoiding the pellet.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Remove residual ethanol using a pipette set to 20 µL.
Remove from magnetic rack, add 27 µL of molecular grade water, and mix by pipetting 10x.
Place plate back on magnetic rack for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Synthesize first-strand cDNA from the cleaned nucleic acid extract.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL of LunaScript® RT SuperMix to a 0.2 mL PCR reaction tube on ice/cool block.
Add 10 µL of cleaned nucleic acid extract and mix gently by pipetting 5x.
Cap tubes and briefly spin down.
Incubate in a thermocycler (heated lid 105°C) at: 25°C for 2 min, 55°C for 45 min, 95°C for 1 min, then hold at 4°C.
Add 7.5 µL of molecular biology grade water to each sample.
Store cDNA at 4°C (overnight) or -20°C (long term).

steps.title: First-Round PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of PCR for GI and GII.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mastermixes according to Table 2 and Table 3.
Vortex and briefly spin down the mastermix.
Distribute 20 µL of PCR mastermix into 0.2 mL reaction tubes.
Add 5 µL of cDNA for each sample (or 5 µL of molecular biology grade water/positive control for controls).
Seal/cap and spin down to remove bubbles.
Run in a thermocycler using conditions in Table 4 (GI) and Table 5 (GII), with a heated lid at 105°C and ramping speed of 3°C/s.

steps.title: Semi-Nested PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of semi-nested PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mastermixes according to Table 3 and Table 6.
Distribute 20 µL of PCR mastermix into a 96-well plate.
Vortex and spin down the plate.
Add 5 µL of first-round PCR product to sample wells (or 5 µL water for negative control).
Seal/cap and spin down.
Run using conditions in Table 7 (GI) and Table 8 (GII), with a heated lid at 105°C and ramping speed of 3°C/s.

steps.title: Clean Semi-Nested PCR Products
steps.instruction: Remove primers and nucleotides using ExoSAP-IT.

substeps.instruction: Defrost ExoSAP-IT on ice.
Briefly vortex and spin down semi-nested PCR reaction tubes/plates.
Aliquot 10 µL of semi-nested PCR product into a new reaction tube or plate.
Add 4 µL of ExoSAP-IT and seal the vessel.
Incubate with a heated lid (105°C) at: 37°C for 15 min, 80°C for 15 min, then hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Quantify and Normalize Amplicons
steps.instruction: Quantify PCR products and normalize concentrations for pooling.

substeps.instruction: Prepare TapeStation: Remove ScreenTape from packaging, remove bubbles, and let it reach room temperature for 30 min.
Add 1 µL ladder to position A1; load 1 µL of positive and negative PCR/process controls into 0.2 mL tubes.
Cap, vortex, spin down, incubate for 2 min, and measure with Qubit™ (or use 2% agarose gel at 125V for 35 min with 100bp ladder).
Convert Qubit concentrations (ng/µL) to fmol/µL using NEBioCalculator (GI: 1110 bp, GII: 971 bp).
Calculate dilution factors: GI (fmol/µL / 14.83) and GII (fmol/µL / 19.94).
Calculate water volume: (Dilution factor - 1) * 8.
Aliquot 8 µL of cleaned semi-nested GI and GII PCR products into new tubes and add the calculated water volumes.
Vortex and spin down.

steps.title: Pool and Prepare Library
steps.instruction: Pool GI and GII products and perform Nanopore library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Combine 5.75 µL of both diluted GI and GII PCR products for every sample (resulting in a final volume of 11.5 µL containing 200 fmol combined: 85.3 fmol GI and 114.7 fmol GII).
If yield is insufficient, pool undiluted cleaned products and adjust native barcoding input volume (0.75-3 µL) to retain 10 fmol input DNA.
Perform end-prep and barcoding using the Oxford Nanopore Native Barcoding Kit 96 V14 manufacturer's instructions.
Load 45 fmol of library per flow cell (using 1 kb amplicon size for molarity calculation).
Run sequencing at 260 bps with super-accurate basecalling until ≈60,000 reads per barcode are generated.

steps.title: Bioinformatic Processing
steps.instruction: Process raw sequencing data to generate filtered consensus sequences.

substeps.instruction: Split reads using `duplex_tools split_on_adapter`.
Trim primer sequences using `cutadapt` with a provided `primer_sequences.fasta` file.
Filter reads >800bp and randomly sample 90,000 reads using `seqtk`.
Identify and remove chimeras using `minimap2` for all-vs-all alignment and `yacrd` for reporting.

Cluster reads to generate consensus sequences using `NGSpeciesID` (parameters: -t 20, -q 15, --ont, --consensus, --max_seqs_for_consensus 100000, --abundance_ratio 100, -m 1100, -s 200, --rc_identity_threshold 0.9, --aligned_threshold 0.8, --mapped_threshold 0.8).
Align reads against consensus sequences using `kma` to call variants.
Combine and rename consensus sequences using `seqtk rename`.
Trim poorly supported regions using `seqkit locate`, `samtools faidx`, and `bedtools`.
Cluster consensus sequences at 95% identity using `cd-hit-est`.

steps.title: Typing and Coverage Analysis
steps.instruction: Type sequences via CDC tool and calculate read depth using R.

substeps.instruction: Use the CDC Human Calicivirus Typing Tool to type representative sequences and download the Excel results.
In R (≥ 4.1.2), use `openxlsx` to merge the CDC typing results with `kma` mapstat coverage files.
Generate a `coverage_per_genotype_wide.csv` file summarizing read counts per genotype per sample.
Filter out consensus sequences not reported by the CDC or identified as chimeras via `USEARCH v11` (-uchime3_denovo).
Identify putative chimeras by comparing read depths of potential parent types and verify using NCBI Multiple Sequence Alignment Viewer v1.25.0 (similarity ≥95%).
Filter data by removing sequences with <0.1% of the median total aligned reads per sample.
